scenes.text: Sometimes the turbine is fine, the wind is perfect, and the grid operator still tells it to make less.
That's curtailment. Across seven U.S. grid operators, Berkeley Lab counted about 5 percent of potential wind generation curtailed in 2025.
The Southwest Power Pool was highest, at about 9 percent. Back in 2014, it was under 1 percent.
More wind on the same wires means more hours when the wires are full. The full story is on The Hidden Grid.
